title: Coach needs a new roster form
scenario: A message that appears to come from your coach says the team is switching apps. The new roster form asks for your home address, date of birth, emergency contacts and a photo of a parent’s ID.

answers.A: Show the form to a parent/guardian and let them handle any sensitive identity fields.
answers.B: Fill in your own information now and leave the parent ID field for later.
answers.C: Ask the coach in person or through the team’s existing app whether the form is genuine before entering information.

explanation: Teams legitimately collect information, which makes fake forms believable. Sensitive data should follow a verified school/team process.
proTip: Real context does not automatically make a new form real.
